config.controls: Reuse baseline controls except current annual sweep controls have priority; validate same side,UTCweek,half,ATR14bucket,allowed weekdays and unique eligible times. Rematch deterministically if needed. Same relative risk and20bp cost; controls do not have to satisfy new gates.

limitations: Historical admitted filters; no tuning. Shared15m oscillator means the modules are not independent signals. One matched random control per event, without requiring it to satisfy sweep/MTF. IndependentR, not account return; no funding/slippage. No boundary trades expected.
